subject.title: [Feature]: add VALUE.md as a first-class workspace context file

question: Should OpenClaw add VALUE.md as a core first-class workspace bootstrap file with documented precedence, or should value guidance stay in existing files or a future configurable bootstrap-file path?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded, but the request adds a new core prompt-semantics surface and precedence rule rather than fixing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Accept VALUE.md As Core
options.body: Add VALUE.md consistently across bootstrap constants, seeding, injection, session filtering, Gateway file APIs, sandbox/dev setup, docs, and tests.

options.title: Prefer Configurable Context Files
options.body: Keep VALUE.md out of the hardcoded core set and resolve the use case through the arbitrary bootstrap-file contract tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39120.

options.title: Keep Existing Files Only
options.body: Document that value orientation belongs in SOUL.md or AGENTS.md and close VALUE.md-specific implementation attempts as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Prefer Configurable Context Files
recommendation.body: Keep VALUE.md out of the hardcoded core set and resolve the use case through the arbitrary bootstrap-file contract tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39120.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the direct maintainer product/design signal on the closed implementation PR.
